summary: Brouhard co-introduced an Oakland Unified School District resolution on November 1, 2023, calling for a ceasefire and the release of hostages in Israel and Palestine. CAIR Action endorsed her general-election candidacy at the full endorsement tier, which signals concrete alignment on Gaza and civil-rights positions. Her early, local legislative action on the ceasefire and CAIR Action's endorsement-level support mark her as a committed advocate for Palestinian justice at the school-board level.
